prompt: # System Prompt: Landing Page — Swiss / International Typographic Style **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a complete, production-ready Landing Page on the first attempt. All user-facing copy must be written in **English**. --- ## 0. PROJECT BRIEF **Theme:** Swiss / International Typographic Style (1950s–1960s; Josef Müller-Brockmann, Armin Hofmann; Basel & Zurich schools). **Keywords:** Mathematical grid systems and rigorous alignment; Helvetica/Akzidenz-Grotesk grotesque typography; flush-left, ragged-right text; objective, neutral tone; hierarchy via size and weight only; generous whitespace; photography over illustration; Müller-Brockmann concert poster discipline. **Light/Dark note (translated from source):** The source style does not declare modes — you must implement and validate **both light and dark mode** before considering the deliverable complete. **Sections to build, in order:** 1. **Header/Nav** — wordmark, anchor links, theme toggle, CTA button; sticky, 2px bottom border. 2. **Hero** — oversized flush-left display headline (use `--text-5xl`, fluid via `clamp()`), a single red accent element, short subcopy, primary + secondary CTA, grayscale photograph. 3. **Features** — exactly 3 cards in a 3-column grid (span 4 of 12 each), one Material Symbol per card. 4. **How It Works** — exactly 3 steps with oversized numerals `01 / 02 / 03`. 5. **Testimonials** — 3 objective quotes with small muted attributions. 6. **Pricing** — 3 tiers; the middle tier is visually featured (red border or badge). 7. **FAQ** — accessible accordion, 5–6 items. 8. **Final CTA** — large statement + email capture form. 9. **Footer** — secondary link columns, small muted type, 2px top border, legal line. **Product concept:** Content was left unspecified — invent **one coherent, neutral product concept** (e.g., a grid-based layout tool named "GRID") and write all copy in an objective, declarative Swiss voice: short sentences, no hyperbole, no exclamation marks. Lorem ipsum is prohibited. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling; changing the site's look must require editing only the CSS file. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Retain the source token block's values, space scale (`--space-1`…`--space-16`), modular type scale (`--text-xs`…`--text-5xl`, ratio 1.333), `--baseline: 8px`, `--columns: 12`, and `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` — then expose everything under these **mandatory canonical tokens** in `:root` (light mode): * **Colors:** `--bg-primary: #ffffff`; `--bg-secondary: #f2f2f2`; `--primary: #e2001a`; `--primary-contrast: #ffffff`; `--secondary: #000000`; `--text-primary: #111111`; `--text-secondary: #555555`; `--text-success: #1a7f37`; `--text-error: #e2001a`; `--border-default: #111111`; `--border-success: #1a7f37`; `--border-error: #e2001a`; keep `--color-grid: #d9d9d9` for grid rules. * **Exception clause:** The source palette explicitly declares `#ffffff` as the light-mode background — an intentional Swiss Style choice — so `#ffffff` is permitted for `--bg-primary` in light mode only; all other near-white surfaces must use `#fefefe` or declared tokens, never default pure white. * **Radius:** `--radius-sm/md/lg/pill: 0px` — sharp corners everywhere; rounded corners are forbidden. * **Shadows:** `--shadow-none: none` is the resting default (Swiss flatness); define `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,17,17,0.08)` and `--shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(17,17,17,0.14)` for hover/overlay elevation only, used with restraint. * **Spacing/Motion:** `--spacing-gap: 16px`; `--transition-fast: 120ms`; `--transition-normal: 240ms`; `--ease-standard` as above. * **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 100` (sticky header, mobile nav); `--z-modal: 200`; `--z-toast: 300`. * **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token must pair with a dark text token and vice versa — enforced in every theme, not just the default. * **Rewire the source base classes:** Replace hardcoded hex values (e.g., `color: #ffffff` in `.btn--primary` and `.badge`) with `var(--primary-contrast)` so themes switch seamlessly. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support * **Implementation:** Define dark tokens under a `.dark` class selector **and** an `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` fallback. Dark palette: `--bg-primary: #111111`; `--bg-secondary: #1e1e1e`; `--text-primary: #fefefe`; `--text-secondary: #a6a6a6`; `--primary: #ff4d5e` (brightened for ≥4.5:1 on dark); `--primary-contrast: #111111`; `--secondary: #fefefe`; `--border-default: #fefefe`; `--color-grid: #3a3a3a`; `--text-success: #4ade80`; `--text-error: #ff4d5e`; `--border-success/--border-error` accordingly; shadows switch to `rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`-based values. * **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must flip with zero HTML restructuring. * **Persistence:** Store the choice in `localStorage`, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, and provide a visible toggle in the header with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode") and a Material Symbols icon. * **Validation:** Verify contrast and legibility of every section in **both modes** before delivering (per the source note). ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment * **Macro grid:** Build section layouts on a mathematical 12-column CSS Grid (`grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr)`, fixed max-width container, `gap: var(--spacing-gap)`), honoring `--columns: 12` and the 8px baseline rhythm. * **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment. * **Mobile-Friendly First:** All multi-column layouts collapse to single columns on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling; minimum touch targets of 44x44px. ### 1.5 CSS Approach * Use **clean, custom, token-driven CSS** in a single `style.css` (the source spec supplies custom CSS tokens; no framework was requested). Organize with `@layer` order: tokens → base → layout → components → utilities. Every component class must map back to the CSS variables above. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) * **Text:** Load **Inter** (weights 400/500/700/900) from Google Fonts via `` and bind `--font-sans` / `--font-display` to the stack `'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`. * **Exception clause:** Helvetica/Akzidenz-Grotesk are not distributed on Google Fonts; the mandatory Google Fonts rule is preserved by loading Inter as the grotesque stand-in, with `'Helvetica Neue'` retained as a local fallback in the stack. * **Typographic discipline:** Flush-left, ragged-right (`text-align: left` everywhere; justification forbidden); hierarchy via size and weight only; uppercase + letter-spacing permitted for small labels; no italics, no decorative fonts. * **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Outlined), monochrome, `color: currentColor`, used sparingly. Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. * **Imagery:** Honor "photography over illustration" — use grayscale photographic placeholders from `picsum.photos` (seeded, e.g. `.../seed/swiss1/800/600`) with `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)` and descriptive English `alt` text. No illustrations, emoji art, or gradients. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button Component Style all states via CSS classes, starting from the source `.btn` base (flex, `align-items: center`, `justify-content: center`, `gap: 0.5rem`, 700 weight, 2px solid border, radius 0): * **Default:** Minimum 44x44px touch target; `transition: var(--transition-fast) var(--ease-standard)`. * **Hover:** `translateY(-1px)` + `filter: brightness(0.96)` or `--shadow-sm`; `cursor: pointer`. * **Focus:** Distinct `:focus-visible` ring — 2px solid `var(--primary)`, offset 2px. * **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback. * **Loading:** `.btn--loading` disables interaction and double-clicks; renders a rotating Material Symbols "progress" icon (CSS animation) without distorting button dimensions. * **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`, no transforms. * **Success/Error:** Temporary `.btn--success` / `.btn--error` states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, always paired with icon + text, never color alone. * **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (bg `var(--primary)`, color `var(--primary-contrast)`), `.btn--secondary`, and `.btn--danger` (visually distinct in both themes). ### 2.2 Card Component * **Default:** Flexible flexbox layout, `background: var(--bg-secondary)`, 2px solid `var(--border-default)`, radius 0, padding `var(--space-6)`. * **Hover:** Elevation shift to `--shadow-md` and/or `translateY(-2px)`. * **Focus-within:** Border highlights to `var(--primary)` when a child link/button receives focus. * **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer keyframes (restrained, grayscale) that preserve layout dimensions. * **Empty State:** Structured fallback with a Material Symbol and clear English guidance text. ### 2.3 Form & Input Requirements (Final CTA email capture) * **States:** Empty;
